description: Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development and Evaluations. For rating quality of evidence in systematic reviews.

questions.question: Is there low risk of bias in the study design and execution?
Is the evidence directly applicable to the research question?
Is the effect estimate clinically meaningful?
questions.guidance: Effect size crosses minimal important difference.

questions.question: Is there low suspicion of publication bias?
questions.guidance: Funnel plot, registry search, or comprehensive search.
